thread:
pagerduty: Incident PDI-99012 triggered -> alb/tls-handshake-failure spike (>5% over 10m). Paging primary oncall.

Jamie (oncall): Acked. I'm taking this. Seeing customer reports for increased 5xxs from eu-west-1 at ~14:04 UTC. @Sasha please pull ALB target group health and any recent cert or listener changes.

Sasha (infra): Checking ALB tg 'tg-eu-main' -> 5/10 targets Unhealthy. Reason shows 'TLS handshake failed'. No autoscaling events. Found a `ci/edge-cert-rotate` job completed at 13:52 UTC (deploy ID: edge-cert-2026-04).

Alejandro (sre): Quick TLS probe from eu tester:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect api.redwood-inference.com:443 -servername api.redwood-inference.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=2 C = US, O = Let's Encrypt
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
SSL handshake has read 512 bytes and written 221 bytes
write:errno=104
```
Seeing intermittent "unable to get local issuer certificate" and 'wrong version number' in nginx-proxy logs. Suggests cert chain issue or missing intermediate during rotation.

Meera (prodops): Customer impact: spike in 5xx for EU customers (approx +12% errors). A few high-traffic tenants (Zephyr, Marketly) showing failures. Setting status page to Investigating and drafting comms.

Sasha (infra): Also checked ALB listener TLS policy -> unchanged. Cert rotation replaced cert-id cert-2026-04. I'm listing certificate details now.

Alejandro (sre): Correlation: cert rotate completed 13:52, errors start ~13:55. Strong candidate. Quick mitigation options: rollback cert -> previous cert-2025-11, route traffic to standby ALB via Route53 weighted policy, or detach problematic targets from TG.

Jamie (oncall): Mitigation plan (parallel):
- A) Shift weight to standby-eu ALB via Route53 (low TTL).
- B) Roll back edge cert to cert-2025-11.
- C) Temporarily relax ALB healthcheck (timeout 12s) to avoid flapping.
I'll do A + C. @Alejandro start B. @Meera prepare customer note.

Sasha (infra): Route53 change ready, TTL 30s. Command:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z84XXX --change-batch '{
  "Changes": [{
    "Action": "UPSERT",
    "ResourceRecordSet": {
      "Name": "api.redwood-inference.com",
      "Type": "A",
      "SetIdentifier": "standby-eu",
      "Weight": 80,
      "AliasTarget": {"DNSName":"standby-eu-alb-777.elb.amazonaws.com","HostedZoneId":"ZELB"}
    }
  }]
}'
```
Applying now (13:59 UTC).

deploy-bot: cert-rollback job edge-cert-2026-04 -> initiating rollback to cert-2025-11 (job 8921).

Alejandro (sre): Triggered rollback pipeline at 13:58 UTC. Watching deploy logs, verifying that the intermediate chain is present after rollback.

Sasha (infra): Dig checks: after ~45s many resolvers point to standby-eu ALB. TG unhealthy count trending down -> 5 -> 2 within 90s.

Jamie (oncall): Healthcheck tweak applied (timeout -> 12s, interval 10s, healthy threshold 2). Restarting 2 ingress pods to pick up any cert changes.

Meera (prodops): Status update: "Mitigations in flight: traffic routing and cert rollback. Customers may experience intermittent errors while DNS propagates. ETA 20 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alejandro (sre): Rollback completed 14:03 UTC. Re-probing TLS shows successful handshakes from multiple locations. Logs show TLS errors drop off. I captured a sample successful s_client output.

Jamie (oncall): Observability: 5xx rate in EU dropped from ~14% -> ~2% in last 6 minutes. Appears stable. Recommend holding rollback until we validate cert creation pipeline.

Meera (prodops): Draft customer comms: "We identified a certificate rotation that caused TLS handshake failures for a subset of EU traffic. We reverted the rotation and rerouted traffic; service is recovering. We will follow up with a timeline and remediation plan." Ready to send on Alejandro confirmation.

Alejandro (sre): Approved. Created incident channel #inc-pdi-99012 and postmortem ticket INC-2026-198. Action items: add TLS smoke-test post-cert-deploy, fail-deploy-on-tls-failure, and verify intermediate chain packaging in cert pipeline.

Jamie (oncall): Handoff note: I need to step out at 14:12 UTC for a quick meeting. @Alejandro you'll be primary for next 40m; @Sasha maintain DNS/ALB follow-ups. Logging handoff in PagerDuty.

pagerduty: On-call handover recorded: Jamie -> Alejandro for PDI-99012 at 14:07 UTC.

StatusBot: Status page updated -> "Identified: certificate rotation caused TLS handshake failures; rollback and routing mitigations applied. Impact reduced to <1% errors. Monitoring."

Sasha (infra): Post-mitigation: planning follow-up tasks -> add `post-deploy` check that validates the full cert chain via openssl s_client from multiple regions, and add an automated rollback trigger in CD pipeline if TLS errors exceed threshold within 10 minutes.

Meera (prodops): Scheduling customer follow-up at +2h with full timeline and remediation. Notifying affected accounts support owners now.

Jamie (oncall): Leaving handoff. Thanks team. Will check back in in 30m.

-- end of thread --
